description: Connect Claude Desktop to Titer, the free Prism-compatible statistics and graphing app for researchers. Claude talks to Titer on your own machine — your data never leaves your computer.
long_description:
Titer is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0) statistics and graphing app for researchers. This extension lets Claude Desktop read what is open in Titer through its built-in MCP server: list projects and tables, read results and graphs — all on your machine, over loopback only.

Before installing: in Titer, open Settings → AI connections and turn on 'Allow AI apps to connect'. The bridge reads Titer's local connection file to find the server; no token or setup is needed here.
name: titer
